maddeler.e:
حججت (form I)
# حَجَجْتُ (ḥajajtu) /ħa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# حَجَجْتَ (ḥajajta) /ħa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# حَجَجْتِ (ḥajajti) /ħa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# حُجِجْتُ (ḥujijtu) /ħu.d͡ʒid͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَجَّ (ḥajja)
# حُجِجْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
